title: Relief allocation text promised the fodder relief would prevent this… @ wolf_winter
excerpts: Relief allocation text promised the fodder relief would prevent this step's cattle-alarm increase, but alarm still rose by 1 here; the benefit apparently applied only to the later LURE feed action instead.
Consequence text said the fodder allocation prevents the ridge's +1 cattle-alarm increase, but alarm still rose from 0 to 1 immediately.
Consequence said fodder prevents Exposed Ridge's +1 cattle alarm, but alarm rose to 1 immediately anyway; the actual suppression happened on a later action instead.
Fodder allocation text claimed it would prevent Exposed Ridge's +1 cattle alarm, but cattle alarm still rose by 1 on that action.
Reward text promised fodder allocation prevents Exposed Ridge's +1 cattle alarm, but cattle alarm still rose to 1 on that action with no visible mitigation.
